items.rationale: Covered under 2.4.4(b) and 7.1.9: frost-related fracture of an internal fitting, including like-for-like replacement, labour, and necessary materials. Reference Case 16 shows t between 48 and 55 for a similar fitting.
Covered as a necessary connection element renewed with the fractured fitting (7.1.9). Reference Case 16: t between 27 and 33 for a similar hose.
Labour for covered repair (7.1.7(f), 7.1.9). Reference Case 16: t >= 274 for 3 hrs senior installer. Full amount indemnified.
Consumables for covered repair (7.1.7(e)), but reference Case 16: t below 11, possibly 0 (lowest charge proven too high).
Ancillary charge for attendance on covered work (7.1.11). Reference Case 16: t >= 60 for similar vehicle costs.
Leak location is covered (2.4.6, 5.1(b)), but reference Case 16: t below 57, possibly 0 (lowest charge proven too high).
